I am experiencing a submission issue with ARC Prize 2026 – ARC-AGI-3.

Runtime: approximately 19.2 seconds
Accelerator: RTX Pro 6000 GPU
Notebook execution completes without an exception

I can provide the notebook/version details and screenshots if helpful.

Thanks!
